create a new API token.

Usage:
  hatchet-admin token create [flags]

Flags:
  -e, --expiresIn duration   Expiration duration for the API token (default 2160h0m0s)
  -h, --help                 help for create
      --name string          the name of the token (default "default")
      --tenant-id string     the tenant ID to associate with the token

Global Flags:
      --config string   The path the config folder.
      --version         print version and exit.
